items.title: meta/astryx
items.summary: Developed by Meta, astryx is a fully customizable open-source design system designed for use by both humans and artificial intelligence agents. Prepared in TypeScript, this system aims to support human and artificial intelligence collaboration in modern software development processes.

snapshot.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready. An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.

items.title: sherlock-project/sherlock
items.summary: Developed in Python, sherlock-project/sherlock is a tool that scans for social media accounts across different networks using usernames. The project offers community-maintained package support for various platforms such as Debian, Ubuntu, Homebrew, Kali, and BlackArch.

snapshot.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks. Community-maintained packages are available for Debian (>= 13), Ubuntu (>= 22.10), Homebrew, Kali, and BlackArch. These packages are not directly supported or maintained by the Sherlock Project.

items.title: tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
items.summary: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework focused on rapid user interface development. It provides predefined classes to accelerate the design process in web projects.

snapshot.description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development. For help, discussion about best practices, or feature ideas:

items.title: mbillow/localthings
items.summary: mbillow/localthings allows you to control Samsung home appliances with the smart home management platform Home Assistant over a local network without requiring a cloud account. Developed in Python, this tool moves control over your devices directly to your local network.

snapshot.description: Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account. Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account.

items.title: ranxianglei/billion-context
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, billion-context is a compression plugin that works on the context window, which refers to the information capacity that AI models can process at once. This tool aims to reduce token usage by five times by fitting billions of tokens into smaller spaces during long monthly sessions.

snapshot.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens) .上下文压缩插件，月级长会话会话， 兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token) . billion-context is all you need

items.title: dsx-ai-factory/nvke
items.summary: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) provides a management plane that enables the management of GPU-accelerated Kubernetes clusters on bare metal servers. Developed in Go, this tool runs on Docker infrastructure with virtual TPM support, simplifying cluster setup and workload creation processes.

snapshot.description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal. The local quickstart runs on a Linux host or VM, amd64 or arm64, with at least 6 CPUs, 12 GiB of free memory and 100 GiB of free disk. It requires Docker, virtual TPM support and the tools listed in the guide. Follow its setup through workload-cluster creation and confirm the cluster's nodes report Ready.

items.title: Need for Speed Underground 2 online in the browser
items.summary: Need for Speed Underground 2 has been made playable via a browser using WebGPU technology. This fan-developed project offers 120 FPS support, widescreen mode, and online racing capabilities.

snapshot.description: Play Need for Speed: Underground 2 (2004) in Chrome and Firefox with WebGPU graphics, Web Audio, up to 120 fps widescreen, controller support, free roam and Online races with friends. Fan project, not affiliated with Electronic Arts.

items.title: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
items.summary: An undocumented family member classifier found on Apple devices is used to create a personal knowledge graph. This feature provides a structure that identifies family relationships by analyzing user data within the scope of Apple Intelligence.

items.title: What I run on my $10 USD OpenStick homelab
items.summary: A homelab set up on a ten-dollar OpenStick device demonstrates how low-cost hardware can be used for server functions. This setup offers the opportunity to experience methods for building personal digital infrastructure on a limited budget.

snapshot.description: What I run on my $10 USD OpenStick homelab

items.title: The end of Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group
items.summary: The AI Frontiers group, operating under Microsoft Research, is being shut down. This development signals a restructuring of research activities within the tech giant Microsoft.

items.title: Apple’s grey list: Words and phrases your iPhone won’t help you spell
items.summary: Apple maintains a list of over 100,000 words and phrases that the predictive text feature is prevented from completing. These restrictions prevent the device from suggesting or automatically correcting specific word groups for the user.

snapshot.description: There are more than 100,000 words and phrases that the tech giant has restricted its predictive text from completing, research shows

items.title: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic
items.summary: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic is presented as an AI model focused on text generation. Showing an average success rate of 94.50 percent on vLLM in GSM8K tests, the model aims to approach the performance of larger models with its 9B parameter size.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. The NVFP4 checkpoint was evaluated on GSM8K four times, and the resulting scores were averaged. Its four-run mean accuracy is 94.50% under vLLM. In the comparison supplied with this release, the 9B student slightly exceeds the reported DeepSeek-V4-Pro teacher result and approaches the Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct reference.
